title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
summary: Simon Willison summarizes METR's RCT (19% slowdown despite a perceived 20% speedup) and debates learning-curve and familiar-repository explanations with one of the authors.
